title: Formation Dynamics of Inorganic Iodine Species During UV-based Advanced Oxidation of Iopamidol and Iohexol and Their Correlation with Iodinated Disinfection Byproduct Yields
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00393H, Paper
Hojoong Ji, Jaehyeong Park, Seonyoung An, Seo-Yeong Choi, Jong Kwon Choe
Iodinated contrast media (ICM) are iodine-containing micropollutants detected in both natural and engineered water systems. These compounds serve not only as contaminants but also as precursors to iodinated disinfection byproducts...
